summary: Prompt: render documentLayer + dossier capsules in the FACTS block; amend ATLAS_RULES to mark dossier text as curated apparatus — framing only, never citable as a primary passage
description: formatFacts (src/lib/prompt.ts) renders documentLayer stats and the dossierCapsules as a distinct block. Amend ATLAS_RULES: dossier text is curated apparatus — the essay may use it to situate and frame cited passages (what the work is, its context, its declared themes) but must never quote it as a primary passage or derive statistics from it; numbers still come only from FACTS. Both new blocks render conditionally (absent on old snapshots). Done: atlas-prompt.test.ts asserts the blocks render, the rules text ships, and an undossiered snapshot renders without the capsule block.
